title: Phase 3 — macro vs champion head-to-head (macro effect sign-flips)
summary: Matched A/B under the champion regime (trailing split + default auto FS+HP loop, max_iter 5). Macro effect SIGN-FLIPS across cells: hurts +20%/25d (R-p@1 0.347->0.120), helps +50%/50d (R-p@1 0.120->0.360) — and flips vs the date_aligned A/B (_259) where macro helped +20%. Macro is NOT a robust improvement and does NOT beat the deployed champions. Default-auto champbase also far below the agent-tuned committed champions (window + tuning-mode confound). Objective 'outperform the existing models' NOT met. Recommend: keep F17 opt-in, do NOT promote to champion / daily-predictions.
